description: analogRead of the ATtiny85 on A1-A3 and by channel number with the VCC, 1.1 V and 2.56 V reference (REFS2 at bit 4 of ADMUX).
basis: ATtiny85 datasheet 17.13 and table 17-3: ADC = floor(Vin * 1024 / Vref), at most 1023; Vref = VCC (5 V) for DEFAULT, 1.1 V for INTERNAL1V1, 2.56 V for INTERNAL2V56 (REFS2:0 = 110); ATTinyCore analogRead takes the channel (pin & 127), A<n> = 0x80 | n; channels 1, 2, 3 are PB2, PB4, PB3; computed by hand: 2.51 V -> 514, 5 V -> 1023, 0.5 V -> 102 (VCC), 465 (1.1 V), 200 (2.56 V)
